hero_lead: Questions about donating, volunteering, company matching, or our upcoming event? We'd love to hear from you.
intro_heading: We're a volunteer team, and we always write back.
intro_paragraph: Whether you're mailing a check, asking about wire instructions, exploring company matching, or want to join us at Networking for a Cause on September 23, 2026 in New York City, reach out below.
info_1_text: Use the contact form, and our volunteer team will follow up by email, typically within a few business days.
info_2_text: Wednesday, September 23, 2026: RSM offices, New York City. Ask about tickets and sponsorship in the form.
info_3_text: Checks are payable to "Baal Dan Charities." Request our current mailing address through the form.
legal_paragraph_1: © 2026 Baal Dan Charities USA. All rights reserved. Baal Dan Charities is a 501(c)(3) US-registered public charity, Federal EIN 20-4658983.
legal_paragraph_2: Information submitted through this site is used solely to respond to your inquiry or process your donation, and is never sold to third parties. Payment processing for online gifts is handled securely by PayPal.
